meta.description: Evaluation cases for the KPI Assistant. Each case is a fictional but realistic project. Run with `npm run eval:kpi`. Assertions are checked after validateAndScore().

assertionTypes.mustIncludeAnyLibraryIds: At least one suggestion (anywhere in the framework) uses one of these library ids
assertionTypes.mustIncludeLibraryIdForResult: For the given resultId, at least one suggestion uses one of these library ids
assertionTypes.maxPerResult: No result has more suggestions than this number
assertionTypes.peopleIndicatorsHaveSex: Every people-level suggestion includes sex or sex_of_household_head in disaggregation
assertionTypes.noTargetsWithoutBasis: No suggestion has targetBasis 'document' unless the value appears in documentFacts
assertionTypes.noTargetInName: No suggestion name contains a target value or direction phrase
assertionTypes.hasAccountabilityIndicator: At least one AC-* library id or an accountability custom indicator is suggested
assertionTypes.arabicNamesPresent: Every suggestion has a non-empty nameAr containing Arabic characters
assertionTypes.minQualityScoreAverage: Average quality score across suggestions is at least this number

project.name: Emergency water supply and hygiene for displaced families in Khan Younis
project.description: Water trucking, rehabilitation of community water points, hygiene kit distribution and hygiene promotion for displaced households.

resultsChain.text: Reduced risk of water-borne disease among displaced populations in Khan Younis
Displaced households have access to sufficient safe water for drinking, cooking and hygiene
Safe water delivered through trucking and rehabilitated water points
Displaced households practise key hygiene behaviours
Hygiene kits distributed and hygiene promotion sessions conducted

documentFacts.excerpt: The action will rehabilitate 18 community water points and distribute 4,000 hygiene kits.

project.name: Skills for Work: vocational training and job placement for young people in Hebron
project.description: Market-driven TVET in partnership with private sector employers, on-the-job training and job matching for youth aged 18–29.

resultsChain.text: Reduced youth unemployment in Hebron governorate
Young women and men trained by the project secure decent employment or self-employment
Youth complete market-relevant vocational and on-the-job training
Employers engaged in curriculum design and work placements

documentFacts.excerpt: Target: 900 youth (50% women) complete training; 60% employed within six months.

project.name: Psychosocial support for children and caregivers in Jenin camp
project.geographicScope: Jenin city and camp, West Bank
project.description: Structured group psychosocial activities for children, focused individual support with referral, and positive parenting sessions for caregivers.

resultsChain.text: Children affected by violence show improved psychosocial well-being and functioning
Children receive structured group and focused psychosocial support
Caregivers provide supportive care at home
Caregivers complete positive parenting sessions

project.name: Climate-resilient farming for smallholders in the Jordan Valley
project.description: Water-efficient irrigation, climate-smart practices, farmer field schools and market linkages for date and vegetable producers.

resultsChain.text: Smallholders adopt climate-smart, water-efficient practices
Smallholders trained through farmer field schools and supported with irrigation equipment
Smallholders increase productivity and sales

project.name: Multipurpose cash and food assistance for vulnerable households in Gaza City
project.description: Monthly e-vouchers and in-kind food parcels for food-insecure households, with post-distribution monitoring.

resultsChain.text: Targeted households maintain adequate food consumption
Food-insecure households receive monthly food assistance

project.name: Catch-up learning and teacher support in Nablus schools
project.description: Remedial Arabic and mathematics for grades 3–6, teacher training in active learning and classroom-based assessment.

resultsChain.text: Children in target schools improve foundational reading and mathematics
Children attend remedial learning sessions
Teachers apply active learning and formative assessment
Teachers complete the training package

project.name: Women-led micro-enterprise growth in Ramallah and Al-Bireh
project.description: Business training, small grants, mentoring and access to finance for women entrepreneurs.

resultsChain.text: Women-led micro-enterprises grow their sales and sustain operations
Women entrepreneurs receive training, grants and mentoring
Women participants have greater say in household economic decisions

project.name: Citizen participation in local government planning in Bethlehem governorate
project.description: Support to grassroots CSOs and municipalities for participatory budgeting and community scorecards.

resultsChain.text: Municipal plans and budgets reflect citizen priorities
Grassroots CSOs trained and engaged in participatory planning
Residents are more satisfied with municipal services
